proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.unlimited
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is activated repeatedly with a Magic action but does not spend charges, uses, or rest-gated resources. Current activated magic items require a resource and reset cadence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form.

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.create_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The core mechanic is creating a persistent tower/structure in the play space with its own footprint and state. The current surface has no honest object-creation effect for magic items.
proposed_widenings.evidence: cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_created_object_handle
proposed_widenings.justification: Follow-up rules need to refer to the created tower itself for empty-only reversion, door commands, and persistent damage across shrinking and re-expansion.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty... Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower.

notes: Stopped before authoring content. Coercing this into alter_item_kind or a charge-based activation would lose the persistent created-object semantics, empty-only revert gate, and reusable no-resource activation.
